title: Mayhem in the Multiverse
intro: [dramatically] Welcome to Disney Jeopardy, where tonight there are infinite universes and only one host. Probably. [chuckles] From time-keepers to conquerors, this is the Multiverse Saga. Mind the incursions.

art.prompt: A swirling cosmic portal of fractured kaleidoscopic city skylines folding in on themselves, rainbow light spilling out, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Phase Four Files
categories.intro: We open the Phase Four case files. [whispers] Several are stamped classified.

art.prompt: A stack of sealed dossiers on a metal desk under a green banker lamp, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Shang-Chi's father leads this ancient criminal organization.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Ten Rings! Ten rings, one very complicated dad.

clues.clue: Shang-Chi's mother came from this hidden magical village.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ta Lo! [warmly] Dragons, guardian lions and fancy fabric.

clues.clue: In Eternals, a Celestial is growing inside the Earth. Its name is this.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is Tiamut! He left a very large hand in the ocean.

clues.clue: In Black Widow, this general runs the Red Room.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dreykov! [dramatically] He didn't see that coming. He couldn't smell it either.

clues.clue: America Chavez punches open portals between universes in this shape.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a star! Five points of pure multiverse travel.

categories.title: Kang Konundrums
categories.intro: He who remains, he who conquers, he who confuses us all. [chuckles] Here come the Kang questions.

art.prompt: A towering throne of green and purple crystals inside a strange glowing subatomic city, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania's main villain is this exiled conqueror.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is Kang the Conqueror! He conquers. It's right there in the name.

clues.clue: In Quantumania, Darren Cross returns as this floating, big-headed villain.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is MODOK! Mechanized Organism Designed Only for Killing. Rude.

clues.clue: In Quantumania, the original Wasp, who spent 30 years trapped in the Quantum Realm, is this woman.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Janet van Dyne! She had some things to tell the family.

clues.clue: In Season 1 of Loki, this TVA judge oversees Loki's case.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ravonna Renslayer! [dramatically] Her comic roots tie back to Kang.

clues.clue: Season 2 of Loki introduced this TVA repair technician who writes the manuals.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Ouroboros! O.B. to his friends. Read the manual.

categories.title: Multiverse Map
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows a strange place in the multiverse. Name it.

art.prompt: An old explorer map unrolled on a desk, covered in glowing swirling circles and branching lines, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Doctor Strange folds whole cities in this pocket reality. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Mirror Dimension! Great for fights, terrible for directions.

clues.clue: The TVA protects this single approved flow of time. Name it. Pictured: a single bright golden line of light stretching through space with faint branches splitting off and being snipped away.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Sacred Timeline! [whispers] Stray from it and the TVA comes knocking.

media.prompt: A single bright golden line of light stretching through space with faint branches splitting off and being snipped away, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This realm outside of time is home to Dormammu. Name it.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is the Dark Dimension! Purple, endless and very loopy.

clues.clue: Scott Lang's family gets pulled into this subatomic world full of odd creatures. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Quantum Realm! [chuckles] Bring snacks. Time is weird down there.

clues.clue: When two universes collide like this, heroes call it this.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is an incursion! Two worlds enter, nobody leaves.

categories.title: Campus Construction
categories.intro: To the parks for some harder hero history. [chuckles] Hard hats on, recruits.

art.prompt: A theme park construction site at dawn with cranes, scaffolding and a half-built futuristic tower, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Avengers Campus at Disney California Adventure was built mostly on the site of this former kid-sized land.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a bug's land! Out with Flik, in with the Avengers.

clues.clue: A full-size version of this Avengers aircraft perches atop Avengers Headquarters at the campus.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Quinjet! [excited] Parking is tricky up there.

clues.clue: Next door to Pym Test Kitchen, grown-ups sip craft beer at this lab.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Pym Tasting Lab! Science, but make it a pint.

clues.clue: At Disneyland Paris, this hero coaster took over the former Rock 'n' Roller Coaster building.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Avengers Assemble: Flight Force! Iron Man and Captain Marvel drive. Very fast.

clues.clue: At Hong Kong Disneyland, the Iron Man Experience and Stark Expo are found in this land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tomorrowland! [excited] Tony fits right in with the future.

categories.title: Variant Trivia
categories.intro: Our fan category: variants, cameos and wild what-ifs. [whispers] Pay attention to the post-credits.

art.prompt: A hall of mirrors where each reflection shows a slightly different glowing silhouette, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: In What If...?, Peggy Carter takes the super-soldier serum and becomes this hero.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Captain Carter! Union Jack shield, perfect posture.

clues.clue: Spider-Man: No Way Home united this many live-action Spider-Men.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is three! [laughs] The pointing meme, live and in person.

clues.clue: In Multiverse of Madness, Earth-838 is protected by this secret council of heroes.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is the Illuminati! Things did not go well for them.

clues.clue: Richard E. Grant plays this elderly Loki variant with a classic green-and-yellow costume.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Classic Loki! [excited] Glorious purpose, glorious horns.

clues.clue: In Multiverse of Madness, this actor plays Earth-838's Reed Richards.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is John Krasinski! A fan-cast come true, briefly.
